description.value: Best Buy Liquor #2 is a liquor store on MacMillan Road in the Cedar area of Nanaimo, operated by the Vancouver Island–based Wayne Procter Group. It sits next to the Millway Gas N Go, forming a convenient one-stop cluster for provisions. Part of a multi-location Best Buy Liquor chain spanning Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating liquor store at 1594 MacMillan Road in Nanaimo, part of The Wayne Procter Group's Best Buy Liquor division (#2 MacMillan). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM address and URL are both corroborated by the website; no location-specific phone number is provided in OSM or on the location page.
concerns: Website spells city name as 'Nanimo' (typo for 'Nanaimo') on the location page.
No location-specific phone number available; corporate group number (250-753-2540) is on the contact page but not tied to this store.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible liquor store confirmed by corporate website. A useful provisions stop for touring cyclists in the Cedar/Nanaimo area.
